accuracy.evidence: Checked NC Y3 tell/write time to nearest minute and digital match; builds on Y2 five-minute intervals without repeating only-5s teaching.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked traps: only multiples of 5; swapping past/to; reading :09 as minutes to the hour.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked flagtomin: single-minute nudges and marks; not flagmins (5-minute jumps) or flagclock (hours/half hours).

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked: learner counts 7 marks to 3:07, sets 3:17 and 4:23, makes 5:42, matches 2:09, spots big-number-only myth.

predictions.evidence: Checked tempting wrongs on 3-marks, 3:17 wording, 4:23 past, 5:42 to, 2:09 match, and big-number-only myth.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked why() splits 5-vs-1 marks, past/to swaps, quarter confusion, and raw-minute vs 60-minus errors.

readability.evidence: Checked ages 7–8 kid lines use minute mark/past/to/digital; adult names NC Y3 within family bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked every sentence teaches minute marks, past/to wording, or digital match.

mobile.evidence: Checked clock UI with ±1/±5 lbtn twins and drag; usable near 390 px.

accessibility.evidence: Checked minute buttons plus canvas drag; live aria-label; challenge aria-live; axe expected clean.

sources: UK NC 2013 Maths Y3 Measurement: tell and write the time from an analogue clock to the nearest minute; 12-hour and digital forms
